title: 白雪公主
description: 經典童話，白雪公主與七矮人的故事

sentences.en: Snow White had skin as white as snow.
sentences.zh: 白雪公主有像雪一樣白的肌膚。

sentences.en: The evil queen asked a hunter to kill her.
sentences.zh: 邪惡的皇后命令獵人殺了她。

sentences.en: The hunter let Snow White go.
She found a small house in the forest.
sentences.zh: 她在森林裡找到了一間小房子。

sentences.en: Seven dwarfs lived in that house.
sentences.zh: 七個小矮人住在那間房子裡。
白雪公主和他們住在一起。

sentences.en: The queen gave her a poisonous apple.
sentences.zh: 皇后給了她一顆毒蘋果。

sentences.en: Snow White fell into a deep sleep.
A prince found her and woke her up.
sentences.zh: 一位王子找到她並喚醒了她。
邪惡的皇后受到了懲罰。

sentences.en: Snow White and the prince got married.
sentences.zh: 白雪公主和王子結婚了。
